            THE CARDO WAY​

            As a company, we strive for engagement and collaboration of our team members.​

            Our employees are the company's most valuable assets, and we are dedicated to their satisfaction. ​

            Cardo's culture and leadership approach inspire transparency, information sharing, and listening.

            MEET LAUREN

            Lauren is a consumer-first powersports marketer who enjoys working on strategy, events, partnerships, content, and digital programs. She is integrated in the motorcycling community and rides all things two wheels - street, ADV, and dirt.

            At Cardo, Lauren leads marketing for the Americas as well as the company’s public and media relations efforts globally. She is based in the U.S.

            Join Lauren About MEET LAUREN

            MEET ARIELLE

            Arielle is the Social Media Manager for Cardo’s Outdoor line, where she leads the brand’s social channels and supports the influencer, affiliate, and content programs. With a background in content creation, you’ll often see Arielle both behind and in front of the camera, helping bring Cardo Outdoor to life across platforms.

            Arielle grew up competing in snowboarding and is an avid outdoorswoman who balances her time at work with time spent exploring the mountains of Colorado. In her words, “I love working for Cardo because our products allow people to stay connected with their friends and family while doing what they love.”

            Join Arielle About MEET ARIELLE

            CARDO SYSTEMS ESG CORE VALUES

            MAKING A DIFFERENCE OUR SOCIAL IMPACT 

            We're not just about making communicators but about communicating directly with people. We're committed to being eco-friendly, community-driven, and human-centric. Our mission is simple: balance the needs of our customers, employees, community, and the planet.

            Join us in supporting local communities through social projects and get hands-on with volunteer opportunities. Discover how we're making a real impact, both inside our office and around the world.
